bio.text: Shelly Arnoldi is the Libertarian candidate for Virginia's 8th Congressional District, running with the backing of the Libertarian Party of Northern Virginia.
She lives in the Fairfax County portion of the district and ran in 2025 for the Virginia House of Delegates against Del. Paul Krizek, receiving 2.8% of the vote.
Arnoldi describes herself as a mother, a Navy veteran and a federal engineer.

sources.title: Libertarian takes on Rep. Beyer, pledging to cut government waste, support civil liberties | ARLnow.com
